limitations: One diagnostic capture per version; no confidence intervals or repeatability claim.
Diagnostic runtime is instrumented; its wall time is not the clean source-to-executable clock.
Stage CPU comes from milestone clocks; leaf/owner attribution comes from sampling. Stages below 500 samples have descriptive sample distributions only.
Active-owner and physical-leaf views describe the same samples; do not add them or infer dynamic event counts. Unmapped samples remain in denominators.
Conditional final verification is nested inside observer composition and is excluded from exclusive totals.
Source/checking/book preparation, compiler execution, generated user-program speed and machine-build cost are separate metrics.
The retained complete-output oracle covers this request, not all-language correctness or full native self-host qualification.
